metadata.title: HPC Performance Risk Governance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for explicitly governing security risk acceptance and trade-offs made to achieve performance objectives in high-performance computing environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC schedulers, performance tuning configurations, resource affinity controls, and platform-level optimization settings.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing intentional security–performance trade-offs in HPC platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Performance risk governance assumes established trust in scheduler-mediated HPC execution platforms.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Explicit acknowledgement of performance-driven risk acceptance and trade-offs as described in NIST SP 800-234.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Reduced isolation or disabled safeguards may amplify privilege escalation impact when vulnerabilities are exploited.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Performance-oriented configurations may increase susceptibility to denial-of-service conditions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit documentation, review, and governance of accepted security risks.

metadata.remarks: HPC Performance Risk Governance formalizes the trust assumptions, risk acceptance decisions, and documentation requirements associated with performance-driven reductions in security controls. This pattern does not implement mitigations; instead, it constrains how HPC platforms are configured and composed so that accepted risks are intentional, bounded, and reviewable.

components.title: Performance Risk Documentation
components.description: Documented identification of security controls that are weakened or disabled to achieve performance targets.

components.title: Performance Risk Acceptance
components.description: Formal acceptance of performance-driven security risks by designated institutional authorities.

components.title: Performance Risk Review and Revalidation
components.description: Periodic reassessment of accepted performance risks to validate continued necessity and appropriateness.
